title: Multi-tenant data models
objectives: Tenant-aware composite foreign keys reject data that points at another tenant's entity, even when the referenced numeric ID is valid globally.
The composite foreign key must match both tenant and project ID against a composite referenced key. A cross-tenant reference is rejected at the database boundary.
securityBoundary: A composite FK does not replace RLS, object-level authorization, row ownership checks, or per-tenant token verification. A privileged SQL connection can still query another tenant's rows unless other controls are in place.
